text: Most eligible voters aged 18–29 voted in the 2022 midterm elections.
seenIn: your feed, full of “I voted” stickers

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: CIRCLE, Tufts University: youth turnout in 2022
truthSource.oneLine: CIRCLE estimates 23% of eligible Americans aged 18–29 voted in the 2022 midterms, down from 28% in 2018.

lesson.tip: If everyone you follow posted a sticker, turnout feels high. People who post are not a random sample. Look for an estimate built from voter files, not your timeline.
